commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Alejandro Hernandez has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
90+3' Real Sociedad hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
88' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
85' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
84' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.
83' Substitution. Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) has come on for Robin Le Normand.
81' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but Alex Remiro comes off his line to gather the ball.
77' Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
74' The attendance is 32528.
73' A cross from Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
72' Francisco has decided to substitute Sergio Camello and he is replaced by Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano).
71' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Isi Palazon.
70' Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
65' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 10:13.
62' A substitution has been made. Igor Zubeldia is replaced by Urko Gonzalez (Real Sociedad).
62' Imanol Alguacil prepares a substitution. Andre Silva is replaced by Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad).
62' Substitution. Umar Sadiq leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad).
61' The referee blows his whistle as Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) was too aggressive in his challenge.
60' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:3.
57' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch for Oscar Trejo.

51' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
50' Poor challenge! Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for tripping and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle.

47' Real Sociedad hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

45+2' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Stole Dimitrievski was alert and the score remains the same.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' The Real Sociedad players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
42' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:1.
39' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
38' It looks like Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) saw red with that tackle. Alejandro Hernandez won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
34' The linesman signals that Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
31' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
29' Problems for Imanol Alguacil as Arsen Zakharyan is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) replaces him.
28' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) picks up an injury.
26' A quickly taken corner by Rayo Vallecano.
26' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
22' Francisco appears to have said too much and referee Alejandro Hernandez comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
20' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Sociedad.
19' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
17' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) jumps into a tackle and Alejandro Hernandez signals a foul.
15' Some neat passing and movement from Real Sociedad as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
11' 25:75 – the ratio of ball possession.
9' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
6' Real Sociedad are ruled offside.
5' Looks like Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
2' Rayo Vallecano keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
1' The first half has started.
Real Sociedad will kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez will officiate today.
